description: The package combines one month of experimental smart-water-meter readings and 1.5 years of sewer-flow observations for distribution and infiltration/inflow modelling. This resource is provided by Mohan Doss, Prasanna; Roghani, Bardia; Bosco, Camillo and coauthors. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists PDF, RAR, TXT formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The periods differ by data stream, and the archive was not inspected for missing values or network identifiers. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
